items.title: Simple terminology used during retrosynthesis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Simple terminology used during retrosynthesis: a main subheading of 25.1.2 Retrosynthesis, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 135-136.

items: Retrosynthetic arrow aik open-ended (khule sire wala) arrow hai, jise ⇒ se dikhate hain. Is ka matlab hai: "yeh is se ban sakta hai".
Target Molecule (TM) woh molecule hai jise banana hai; retrosynthesis mein isi ko disconnection se toora jata hai.
Disconnection woh process hai jis mein TM ko kaghaz par, imaginary (khayali) tor par, step by step simple starting materials mein toora jata hai.
Synthons target molecule ke woh fragments (tukre) hain jo disconnection se bante hain. Yeh aksar ions hote hain aur synthesis ke building blocks (banane ki eenten) hain.
Synthetic Equivalent (SE) woh real (asal) reagent hai jo synthon ka kaam karta hai, kyun ke synthon aam tor par unstable (na-paidar) hota hai aur khud istemal nahi ho sakta.
Functional Group Interconversion (FGI) target molecule tak pohanchne ke liye aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna hai.
Retrosynthetic Tree aik diagram hai jo target molecule se starting materials tak saare possible disconnections aur synthons dikhata hai.

blocks.text: Figure 25.2 yeh saare terms aik hi scheme mein dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Aniline (NH2 wala benzene ring), 'Target Molecule (TM)', open arrow 'FGI' se nitrobenzene tak, jis ke C-N bond par wavy slash (lehredaar line) hai. Cyan open arrow 'Disconnection' do arrows mein batt jata hai: oopar synthon (A), negative charge wala benzene ring, jo benzene (SE) ke barabar hai; neeche synthon (B), positive charge wala NO2, jo HNO3, nitric acid (SE) ke barabar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.2: Retrosynthesis mein istemal hone wali terms (istilahat) (kitab ki Figure 25.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aniline (TM) par NH₂ seedha nahi lagaya ja sakta, is liye pehle FGI se NH₂ ko NO₂ samjha jata hai. Phir C–N bond par wavy (lehredaar) nishan ka matlab hai ke yahan bond kaghaz par toora gaya. Is se do synthons milte hain: negative charge wala phenyl ion (A) aur positive NO₂⁺ (B). Yeh khud stable nahi, is liye teen lines wala nishan (≡, equivalent) un ke asal reagents batata hai: benzene aur nitric acid (SE).

blocks.prompt: Synthon aur synthetic equivalent mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Synthon disconnection se milne wala imaginary (khayali) fragment hai (aksar ion), jo khud istemal nahi ho sakta. Synthetic equivalent woh real, stable reagent hai jo lab mein us synthon ka kaam karta hai; maslan C₆H₅⁻ ke liye benzene aur NO₂⁺ ke liye HNO₃.
